what: Every register row not marked closed, plus every defect a live instrument is measuring that has no register row. The answer to "what is open" — printed, never typed.
why: On 2026-08-11 a hand-typed list of ~30 open defects was read out while the gate sat green: 8 were closed, 4 had never been registered. Nothing printed the open work, so the only list that existed was one somebody typed.
not_a_claim_about_code: A row is OPEN here if nobody marked it closed. That is a statement about the REGISTER. A fixed mechanic whose row was never updated still prints, which is the correct direction to err. UNREGISTERED is the stronger signal — measured, not filed.
